# OMP Session Gateway

> Native integration with stock Oh My Pi (OMP) >=18.1.20. No OMP fork, custom build, gateway-specific OMP plugin or publisher credential. Stable v0.7.7 is published as immutable GitHub Latest. The separate gateway discovers collaboration-enabled sessions and opens OMP's encrypted View/Control client. Setup requires collab.autoStart, Bun 1.4.0, gateway installation and TUN-mode Tailscale Serve with Funnel disabled. Community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by OMP.
<!-- release-generate:summary:end -->

## Supported platforms

- Tested in CI on every change (with daily stock-OMP canaries on Linux and Windows): Linux, macOS, and Windows gateway hosts; Chrome/Chromium, Edge, Firefox, Safari/WebKit, and Android; iPhone and iPad as a WebKit browser. Supported is not hardware-qualified; qualification is the exact matrix below.

## Current qualification boundary

<!-- release-generate:boundary:start -->
Stable v0.7.7 is published as immutable GitHub Latest. [Release v0.7.7](https://github.com/carrythroughsystems/omp-session-gateway/releases/tag/v0.7.7). Signed candidate v0.7.7-prealpha.2; source c8da6e07cc62b7b855c509037a827f082b564c69; archive SHA-256 c63b893f163bc6ef1c77c42556645932dc76252b6fefce2b9dcbe21a91eb5705. Published v0.7.6 remains the predecessor. Stock OMP v18.10.2 (c8913466dd7bf92040de911f8e00e30b8f4e48a2), Bun 1.4.0. All thirteen lanes passed; attempt counts and measured evidence are in the [release ledger](RELEASE_STATUS.md). The separate published-byte smoke passed; it does not expand the candidate matrix.

- artifacts (1 attempt): Signed tag, checksums, GitHub attestations 3/3 and Sigstore bundles 3/3; v0.7.6 verified the same way.
- debian (1 attempt): Run 38485221785 succeeded (https://github.com/carrythroughsystems/omp-session-gateway/actions/runs/38485221785); OS/kernel versions and migration counts are not exported.
- macos (1 attempt): VirtualMac2,1, macOS 27.0 arm64; doctor 18/18, rollback 23/23; native addon b137c1ff0cb7eeb6b4f97ea10e7869779f8db33d9e9edb16d04c1250597b900d.
- ompPublication (1 attempt): Stock OMP v18.10.2; generation 1; publication, View/Control, new-generation/fork/resume and revocation.
- android (1 attempt): Pixel 8 Pro, Android 17 build CP3A.261005.005, Chrome 154.0.8037.126; same-page unlock 7052 ms, Airplane 3635 ms, Doze 133 ms; 7/7 detectable; clean.
- androidPush (1 attempt): Android 17, Chrome 154.0.8037.126, installed WebAPK; force-stop delivered_while_force_stopped, Doze delivered_after_doze_exit; outcomes are observed variants, not delivery guarantees.
- androidPushCleanup (1 attempt): Device, browser and fixture restored.
- deviceCloud (1 attempt): TestingBot real devices, tunnel 4.9: iPhone 17 Pro (26.5, safari 26.5); iPad (9th generation) (26.6, safari 26.6); Galaxy S26 (16.0.0, chrome 145.0.7632.159). Home Screen alerts do not qualify lock-screen presentation.
- deviceCloudCleanup (1 attempt): Restored.
- relay (1 attempt): 1800 seconds, 2026-10-13T23:47:25.356Z–2026-10-14T00:17:25.370Z; 8 transitions, final phase live. Eight-hour endurance is not claimed.
- cleanup (1 attempt): Zero gateway processes, listeners and live OMP hosts.
- windows (1 attempt): Windows x86-64 build 26100; 4 CPUs, 8186 MiB; Administrator upgrade/rollback from v0.7.6 and fresh standard-account lifecycle; interactive logon, not unattended boot.
- windowsCleanup (1 attempt): Zero instances and firewalls; tailnet node deleted and access vault removed.

The Mac guest does not qualify physical firmware, FileVault, Secure Boot or startup before login. Cloud devices qualify the browser, not phone-owned Tailscale identity; iPhone Home Screen alerts do not qualify lock-screen presentation. Gateway rollback does not switch OMP. Other hosts and browser builds remain outside this exact matrix. Portal Tunnel and self-hosted/proxied relays are unsupported.

## Fork-era release history
